env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
env GOEXPERIMENT=
env GOARCH=amd64

# Row O-A05: the wasm preemptibleloops default must not leak to amd64
# modules. The wasm control at the end proves the token is observable,
# so the absences above are real.
cd amd64mod
logos env GOEXPERIMENT
! stdout 'preemptibleloops'
go env GOEXPERIMENT
! stdout 'preemptibleloops'
cd ..

env GOOS=js
env GOARCH=wasm
cd amd64mod
logos env GOEXPERIMENT
stdout 'preemptibleloops'
cd ..

-- amd64mod/go.mod --
module example.com/w5preempt

go 1.27

-- amd64mod/main.go --
package main

func main() {}
